{{EventEnded|date = 31st of January 2024|event = [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]}} {{NarratorInfobox |animated_image = SantaDialogue.gif |image-dynamic = SantaDynamic.png |type = Animated |appearances = [[Krampus Frosthold]]
LobbyCould be talked with and acted as an alternative way to access [[Krampus' Revenge Event]] exclusive [[Quests]]. |animations = 1 }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Who ever is behind this is going on the naughty list! |'''Santa''' on Wave 18 of [[Krampus Frosthold]]}} }} ==Description== '''Santa''' was a narrator for the [[Krampus Frosthold]] map. He also appeared in the game's lobby during [[Krampus' Revenge Event]], where he could be interacted with. There, he acted as an alternative way to access exclusive [[Krampus' Revenge Event]] [[Quests]]. '''Santa''' only had one animation. Additionally, while he made his first in-game appearance in [[Krampus' Revenge Event]], he has been mentioned in the past by other characters, such as Ms. Claushttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IpYtAfVVhTE and '''Santa''' himself is aware of events that happened in the game, such as [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]]' defeat in the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]Stated on the final wave of [[Krampus Frosthold]].. He has also been mentioned after his appearances, such as through the [[Santa's Air Strike]] consumable. ==Appearance== '''Santa''' had tan skin and a long, white beard. He wore a red Santa hat and a red Santa coat. In his hand, he held a magnifying glass and a scroll, likely a naughty or nice list. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Santa''' added. *'''31 January 2024''' - [[v1.12.0]]c **'''Santa''' removed. ==Notes== {{NarratorNavBox}}
